meta.how: chart element selected through COM; pane opened with CommandBars.ExecuteMso('ChartFormatSelection'); read through UI Automation; sections expanded and radios selected through automation patterns; dropdowns opened and closed through ExpandCollapse; labels only (no tooltips)
meta.data: A1:C5 Monat/A/B (Jan 4 6, Feb -2 5, Mär 7 3, Apr 5 8); scatter E1:G5 X/Y1/Y2 with X 1, 2.5, 4, 6
meta.chart setup: title, legend, data labels on series 1; except pie: linear trendline and fixed-value error bars (1) on series 1, title on Axes(2), major gridlines on Axes(2); combo: series 2 as line with markers on the secondary axis
meta.fields: t control type; label exact German; value current value (checkbox/toggle true/false, radio selected); range [min, max] when exposed; disabled when greyed; menu: opens a dropdown; entries: its entries; picker 'Farbe': colour picker (entries not recorded); group: sub-heading inside the section; choices: per radio choice (other than the selected one) the controls it adds or removes; same_as: identical to the section (or pane) recorded under that key
